{{Top|leg}}
'''''Rubol''''' was a [[Class-C cargo container|Class-C Cargo Containers]] near the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Cruiser]] ''[[Link]]'' which was attempting to warn the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] stationed on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] that the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was fully operational and the Rebels were heading into a [[Battle of Endor/Legends|trap]]. However, the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] had overloaded and the ship was stranded. The ''Link'' then sent a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] ''[[Fetch]]'' to deliver [[Fuel Rod]]s from [[Class-C cargo container]] '''Rubol''' when it was intercepted and destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who then inspected the container to find fuel rods as well, and destroyed it. Soon the ''Link'' was [[Capture of the Link|captured]] and sent to [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].
